seo.title: VESTIGE | Private investigation and inquiries in Belgium
seo.description: VESTIGE supports individuals, companies, insurers and professionals in verifying facts, researching information and conducting investigations, within a legal and confidential framework.

content.title: Establish the facts. Reduce uncertainty. Decide on a documented basis.
content.text: VESTIGE supports individuals, companies, insurers and professionals facing a situation where facts need to be verified, cross-checked or documented with method, discretion and in compliance with the legal framework.

servicesIntro.title: A <1>fact-based</1> approach
servicesIntro.text: A useful investigation is not about accumulating information. It is about identifying what really needs to be established, choosing appropriate means, verifying the information gathered and delivering to the client a clear, traceable and usable result.

audiences.intro: Choose the area that matches your situation.

individuals.title: Individuals
individuals.text: Private disputes, searches for people or assets, fact verification.

companies.title: Businesses
companies.text: Internal fraud, employee matters, commercial disputes, verifications and investigations.

insurers.title: Insurers
insurers.text: Files involving suspected fraud or inconsistencies to be verified.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.text: Lawyers, advisers, fellow investigators and other professional clients.

principlesIntro.title: The VESTIGE <1>principles</1>
principlesIntro.text: Each assignment is built around <1>four principles</1>:

admissibility.title: Admissibility
admissibility.text: Verifying that the assignment can lawfully be accepted.

proportionality.title: Proportionality
proportionality.text: Using only the means justified by the objective.

traceability.title: Traceability
traceability.text: Dating, sourcing and cross-checking the relevant information.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.text: Limiting access to information and protecting case files.

cta.title: Facing an uncertain situation and wondering whether an <1>investigation</1> is possible?
cta.text: Briefly describe the context. A first conversation helps <1>assess your request before any commitment</1>.

services.mainText: Individuals, businesses, insurers or professionals: every request is first assessed, then handled with a traceable and proportionate method, within the legal framework.

individuals.label: Individuals
individuals.title: Verified facts to shed light on a <h>private</h> situation
individuals.text: Some private situations become hard to resolve because the facts are incomplete, contradictory or impossible to verify alone. VESTIGE can act when an assignment falls within the legal framework of private investigation and the client has a legitimate interest in obtaining the information sought.

seo.title: VESTIGE | Private investigations for individuals in Belgium
seo.description: Searches for people or assets, fact verification and investigations in private disputes: VESTIGE reviews every request before accepting it.

disputes.title: Private disputes and situations
disputes.text:
In a current or potential conflict, an investigation can help clarify specific facts, verify information or document a situation.
The assignment is always limited to a defined objective and to legally admissible means.

people.title: Finding people
people.text:
Finding someone you have lost touch with, checking a location lead or searching for a missing person may require cross-referencing different sources and checks.
The nature of the request and the client's interest are reviewed before any search.

assets.title: Searching for lost or stolen property
assets.text: When property has been lost or stolen, VESTIGE can analyse the available information, check leads and carry out searches compatible with the applicable legal framework.

facts.title: Fact verification
facts.text:
Information can seem credible without being accurate.
VESTIGE distinguishes established facts, converging information and what cannot be confirmed. This distinction is at the heart of the report delivered to the client.

limits.title: What VESTIGE does not do
limits.text:
Discretion never means getting around the law.
VESTIGE refuses in particular any request requiring intrusion, fraudulent access to an account or system, identity theft, the collection of prohibited information or disproportionate methods.

contact.title: First contact
contact.text:
Describe the situation in a few lines, without immediately sending sensitive data or confidential documents about third parties.
If the request can be reviewed, an appropriate channel can then be agreed.

companies.label: Businesses
companies.title: Investigations for <h>businesses</h> and executives
companies.text: A company may have to act while the facts are incomplete: suspected fraud, commercial conflict, harmful behaviour, contradictory information or a risk to document. VESTIGE helps turn this uncertainty into verified factual elements.

seo.title: VESTIGE | Investigations for businesses
seo.description: Internal fraud, commercial disputes, fact verification and investigations: VESTIGE supports businesses with legally admissible private investigation assignments.

fraud.title: Internal fraud and irregularities
fraud.text:
Theft, embezzlement, false expenses, abuse or other irregularities may require a structured investigation.
VESTIGE starts by precisely defining the facts to verify, the people concerned and the means that can lawfully be used.

employee.title: Situations involving an employee
employee.text:
Investigations concerning an employee are subject to a specific framework.
VESTIGE checks the applicable conditions before accepting the assignment and does not start any investigative method based solely on an informal request from management.

commercial.title: Commercial disputes
commercial.text:
In a conflict with a partner, supplier, customer or other economic player, specific facts may need to be established before a decision, a negotiation or legal proceedings.
VESTIGE searches for and cross-checks only the elements relevant to the purpose of the assignment.

partners.title: Checking partners and situations
partners.text:
Before or during a business relationship, certain inconsistencies may justify targeted checks.
The aim is not to build an exhaustive profile of a person or company, but to answer precise and legitimate questions.

research.title: Information research and analysis
research.text:
Registers, publications, open sources, accessible documents and field information can be combined when relevant to the assignment.
OSINT is used as a research method, not as a pretext for collecting everything that is publicly visible.

field.title: Field investigations
field.text:
When documentary research is not enough, field checks or observations may be considered.
They are only carried out if they are necessary, proportionate and permitted by the applicable framework.

report.title: Report for decision-makers
report.text:
The report focuses on what really helps decision-making: established facts, chronology, useful sources, converging elements, unconfirmed points and the limits of the assignment.
It avoids speculative conclusions presented as certainties.

insurers.label: Insurers
insurers.title: Investigations and verifications for the <h>insurance</h> sector
insurers.text: Some insurance files require verifying circumstances, cross-checking statements or documenting inconsistencies. VESTIGE works on clearly defined factual questions, with a traceable and proportionate methodology.

seo.title: VESTIGE | Investigations for insurers and fraud cases
seo.description: Fact verification, consistency of statements, documentary research and field investigations for insurance files, within the applicable legal limits.

fraud.title: Suspected fraud
fraud.text:
When a file shows anomalies or contradictory elements, an investigation can help verify specific facts.
The assignment must be precisely defined: what needs to be established, why, and by what means.

documents.title: Documentary research
documents.text:
Accessible sources can be examined to verify a chronology, links, activities or other elements relevant to the assignment.
The fact that information is public does not automatically mean it can be collected or disclosed.

field.title: Field investigations
field.text: Field checks or observations can complete the file when they are legally admissible and proportionate to the purpose of the assignment.

sensitive.title: Sensitive data
sensitive.text:
Health data and other sensitive categories are subject to specific restrictions.
VESTIGE only searches for, keeps or discloses them when a specific legal basis actually allows it.

report.title: Report
report.text: The report is structured to make the file easy to use: purpose of the assignment, methodology, chronology, findings, sources, useful appendices and limits of the checks carried out.

professionals.label: Professionals
professionals.title: <h>Factual</h> support for professionals
professionals.text: Lawyers, advisers, fellow investigators or other professional clients: when a case depends on facts to be established, VESTIGE works on a precisely defined mandate, after checking its admissibility, and delivers a report that separates findings from hypotheses.

seo.title: VESTIGE | Investigations for lawyers and professionals
seo.description: Fact-finding, tracing, documentary checks and case support for lawyers, advisers and other professionals, subject to admissibility.

lawyers.title: Lawyers and advisers
lawyers.text:
When a case requires verifying facts, finding a person, clarifying a chronology or documenting a situation, VESTIGE can act on a precisely defined mandate.
The report always distinguishes findings from hypotheses and states the limits of the research.

peers.title: Fellow investigators and subcontracting
peers.text: VESTIGE can support other private investigation professionals when the legal conditions for subcontracting are met and the scope of the assignment is clearly documented.

others.title: Other professional clients
others.text:
Every request from a professional is assessed according to its actual purpose.
The client's status never removes the need to verify the legitimate interest, the purpose and the lawfulness of the methods considered.

method.title: A <h>structured</h> investigation before it becomes a field investigation
method.text: Before it becomes a field investigation, every assignment is first qualified, checked and scoped. The steps below structure the entire work, up to the final report.

qualification.title: Qualifying the request
qualification.text:
Who is asking? What is the problem? Which facts really need to be established? What result would be useful to the client?
This first step avoids confusing a general concern with a usable investigative objective.

admissibility.title: Admissibility
admissibility.text: Before any assignment, VESTIGE checks in particular the client's identity, their legitimate interest, the purpose of the request, any conflicts and the restrictions specific to the type of investigation considered.

mandate.title: Defining the mandate
mandate.text:
A useful assignment needs limits.
The purpose, the questions to resolve, the duration, the means considered and the deliverables are defined before execution and adjusted if the situation changes.

collection.title: Collection and investigation
collection.text:
Documentary research, open sources, checks, interviews or field work can be combined depending on the assignment.
Each method remains subject to its own conditions of lawfulness and proportionality.

crosscheck.title: Cross-checking and assessment
crosscheck.text:
An isolated piece of information is not automatically an established fact.
VESTIGE compares sources, checks their date and context, and distinguishes what is confirmed, probable, contradictory or unverifiable.

report.title: Report
report.text:
The final report presents the relevant findings in a structured way.
It sets out the relevant methodology, the established facts, the limits and, where necessary, the documents or appendices that allow the client to understand the factual reasoning.

compliance.title: Built-in compliance
compliance.text:
Compliance is not a step added at the end.
It applies from the acceptance of the assignment and throughout its execution: data collected, methods used, retention, communication to the client and closure of the file.

seo.title: VESTIGE | Private investigation firm in Belgium
seo.description: Discover VESTIGE, an independent private investigation firm based in Wallonia, its method, its values and its approach to investigations.

about.title: VESTIGE, an independent private investigation firm
about.intro: Built around a simple conviction: a professional investigation must produce verified facts that are useful for decision-making, not simply more information.

cabinet.title: The <h>firm</h>
cabinet.text: The firm favours assignments in which the quality of the analysis, discretion, cross-checking of sources and traceability bring real value to the client. VESTIGE works with individuals, businesses, insurers and professionals depending on the nature of the request.
cabinet.founderText: Trained in private investigation and coming from a hands-on professional background, the founder of VESTIGE favours an approach that is concrete, structured and free of overpromising: understanding the situation, defining what can be verified, then documenting the results clearly.

values.title: Our <h>values</h>
values.text: Rigour, discretion, independence, proportionality and confidentiality guide the way assignments are accepted and carried out.

rigor.title: Rigour
rigor.text: Every element is dated, sourced and cross-checked before it appears in a report.

discretion.title: Discretion
discretion.text: Requests are handled with restraint, without needlessly exposing the client or the people concerned.

independence.title: Independence
independence.text: Findings are not shaped by the client's expectations: only verified facts count.

proportionality.title: Proportionality
proportionality.text: The means used remain limited to what the purpose of the assignment justifies.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.text: Access to information is restricted and files are protected, from opening to closure.

zone.title: Area of <h>operation</h>
zone.text:
VESTIGE is based in Wallonia and operates in Belgium depending on the nature of the assignment.
Needs requiring research or checks outside this area are assessed case by case.

seo.title: VESTIGE | Frequently asked questions about private investigation
seo.description: Fees, timing, confidentiality, social networks, observation and reports: answers to frequently asked questions about how a VESTIGE assignment works.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Fees, timing, confidentiality, methods and reports: answers to the most common questions about how a VESTIGE assignment works.

questions.question: How much does an investigation cost?
questions.answer:
The cost depends on the purpose of the assignment, its duration, the means required and any expenses.
Once the request has been assessed, VESTIGE specifies the billing method and provides the necessary information before any commitment.

questions.question: How long does an assignment take?
questions.answer:
There is no standard duration.
A targeted check can be short; a complex situation may require several phases. The scope and checkpoints are defined before execution.

questions.question: What should I send at first contact?
questions.answer:
A brief summary of the situation is enough.
It is better not to send sensitive data or confidential documents about third parties straight away.

questions.question: When does an assignment start?
questions.answer:
A first contact does not mean acceptance.
The assignment only starts after the necessary checks, agreement on its scope and the required formalities.

questions.question: Can an assignment be refused?
questions.answer: Yes. VESTIGE refuses an assignment when it does not meet the legal conditions, when the objective is insufficiently defined, when there is a conflict or when the means requested are prohibited or disproportionate.

questions.question: Can anyone be investigated?
questions.answer:
No. An assignment must serve a legitimate purpose and meet the conditions set by the applicable legislation.
Simply wanting information about a person is not enough.

questions.question: Can social networks and public information be used?
questions.answer:
Sometimes, but not automatically.
The fact that information is publicly accessible does not mean it can always be collected, kept or disclosed. Certain categories of data are specially protected or prohibited.

questions.question: Can a person be followed or observed?
questions.answer:
Observation is a regulated method.
It is only considered when it is necessary, proportionate and permitted in the context of the assignment.

questions.question: Is the information confidential?
questions.answer:
Confidentiality and the security of files are part of the VESTIGE method.
Access to information is limited to the people who actually need to handle it for the assignment.

questions.question: Can the report be used in legal proceedings?
questions.answer:
VESTIGE delivers a factual report based on the findings of the assignment.
The procedural use and evidential value of a document depend on the legal context and, where applicable, on the judge's assessment. A lawyer can advise the client on its use.

You can delete it at any time from your browser settings.
